name: validate_cloudformation_template
description: Validate a CloudFormation template's syntax, AWS resource types, and property schemas using cfn-lint (offline; read-only). Returns is_valid plus error/warning/info counts and per-issue line numbers and paths. Use before returning a generated or refined template.

template_content.description: CloudFormation template as a YAML or JSON string.

regions.description: Optional AWS regions to validate against, e.g. ['ap-south-1'].

ignore_checks.description: Optional cfn-lint rule IDs to ignore, e.g. ['W2001', 'E3012'].

name: check_cloudformation_template_compliance
description: Validate a CloudFormation template against security and compliance rules using cfn-guard (read-only). Returns is_compliant, violation_count, and per-violation remediation guidance. Use to catch insecure configs (public access, missing encryption, weak logging) before returning a template.

template_content.description: CloudFormation template as a YAML or JSON string.

rules_file_path.description: Optional path to a cfn-guard rules file. Omit to use the bundled default rules.

name: search_cloudformation_documentation
description: Search official AWS CloudFormation documentation and return ranked excerpts (resource types, properties, syntax, examples). Use to confirm exact property names and types before authoring a resource.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'AWS::RDS::DBInstance properties' or 'S3 bucket encryption'.

name: get_cloudformation_pre_deploy_validation_instructions
description: Return guidance for CloudFormation change-set pre-deployment validation (the checks CloudFormation applies before provisioning: invalid property syntax, name conflicts, S3 emptiness). Takes no arguments.
